constructions.name: naive completions
constructions.definition: Extend f by a fixed output 0 or 1 on the entire complement of its promise.

constructions.name: natural completion
constructions.definition: For a fixed full-cube approximant to a ±1-valued function, F(x)=+1 when p(x)>=0 and -1 otherwise. It agrees with f on the promise.

constructions.name: domain evaluation matrix
constructions.definition: Rows are promised inputs and columns are the selected Fourier basis functions of a fixed approximant; entry (x,j) is phi_j(x). The surrounding definition chooses a degree-optimal sparsest approximant.

constructions.name: coefficient perturbation
constructions.definition: p_Delta=p+sum_j Delta_j phi_j. Membership in Ker(A_D(p)) preserves values only on the promised domain.

warnings: Natural completion fixes p; minimum-completion complexity minimizes over all total completions.
Coefficient infinity norm does not bound the full-cube function sup norm.
Exact or approximate sparsity in Definition 29 is minimized subject to degree optimality.
